# EduRev

> EduRev is a comprehensive edtech learning platform offering free and premium courses, mock tests, video lectures, and study materials for school exams (CBSE, ICSE), entrance exams (NEET, JEE, UPSC, CAT, CLAT), and competitive assessments.

EduRev serves students across multiple educational boards and competitive exam categories with structured courses, practice tests, revision notes, and NCERT solutions. The platform is available as a web application and mobile app on Google Play, offering both free and subscription-based learning resources.

## Key Topics

- NEET
- JEE Main
- JEE Advanced
- CBSE
- NCERT
- UPSC
- CAT
- CLAT
- Mock Tests
- Video Lectures

- EduRev Infinity
